audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and editing Excel .xlsx workbooks without a commercial license, especially those using Maven for dependency management.

capabilities.text: Create, load, rename, and manage worksheets via Workbook and Worksheet APIs, including visibility control and tab color.
capabilities.title: Workbook and worksheet management

capabilities.text: Read and write string, numeric, boolean, date/time, and formula values to cells, preserving formula expressions across load/save.
capabilities.title: Cell value and formula handling

capabilities.text: Apply full cell formatting including font, borders, fill, alignment, number format, and protection via Style objects.
capabilities.title: Cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Define data validation rules and apply conditional formatting to worksheet ranges using CellArea and related collections.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Embed images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP) and add cell comments with author, text, visibility, and size control.
capabilities.title: Embedded content support

capabilities.text: Create 18 chart types programmatically; preserve ChartEx types loaded from existing workbooks verbatim.
capabilities.title: Chart and shape rendering

capabilities.text: Configure print layout, freeze panes, and apply workbook/worksheet protection with passwords.
capabilities.title: Page setup and print configuration

capabilities.text: Load damaged workbooks with repair options and inspect diagnostics for repair details and preservation notes.
capabilities.title: Repair and diagnostics

limitations.text: Saving is limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in pure Java without runtime dependencies on Apache POI or other third-party libraries.
Supports robust loading of corrupted or non-standard Excel files via strict mode toggles and repair options, with diagnostics reporting.
Provides data validation and conditional formatting capabilities for enforcing and styling data entry rules in spreadsheets.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source Java library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks, targeting Java 17 and using Apache POI only in test scope.

uncertainties: The exact set of unimplemented XML-mapper skeleton classes and their impact on metadata fidelity is not fully specified.
Whether ListObject totals rows and column definitions are fully supported beyond basic creation and styling is unclear.
The behavior of outline grouping for rows/columns in complex hierarchies is not detailed.
Support for Excel tables with structured references beyond basic ListObject operations is not specified.
The scope of 'a handful of public XML-mapper classes' that are unimplemented skeletons is not quantified.
Whether all 38 AutoShapeType geometries support full round-trip preservation is not confirmed.
The exact set of supported Excel functions in formulas is not listed.
Whether workbook-level defined names support complex formulas or external references is not specified.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Developers run 'mvn test' to execute unit tests in src/test/ and 'mvn package' to build the library.

workflows.name: Release workflow
workflows.text: Releases are published to Maven Central using the maven-central-release.yml workflow.

workflows.name: Create and style workbook
workflows.text: Developers instantiate a Workbook, add worksheets, write cell values, apply styles, and save as .xlsx.
